title: Ziyarah on the 15th of Shaban
data:
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ اللّٰهِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA HUJJATALLAAH
Peace be upon you, O Proof of Allah!
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْنَ اللّٰهِ فِيْ خَلْقِهٖ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA A'YNALLAAHI FEE KHALQIH
Peace be upon you, O eye of Allah among His creation!
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ اٰدَمَ صِفْوَةِ اللّٰهِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA WAARITHA AADAMA SIFWATILLAAH
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Adam, the select of Allah!
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوْحٍ نَّبِيِّ اللّٰهِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA WAARITHA NOOHIN NABIYYILLAAH
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Noah, the prophet of Allah!
اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ خَلِيْلِ اللّٰهِ
ASSALAAMU A'LAYKA YAA WAARITHA IBRAAHEEMA KHALEELILLAAH
Peace be upon you, O inheritor of Abraham, the friend of Allah!
merits: There are numerous traditions revealing the merits of visiting Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) on the fifteenth of Sha'ban.
